baseline.toolAuthority: Parent-only existing compiler/git roles; no peer native spawn or new runTool role

common.ownData: Exact finite own keys/data descriptors/primitive values and dense arrays; reject accessors/symbol/nonenumerable/undefined extras before serialization, no prototype equality/coercion. Local reason references excluded from JSON.
common.bindingIds: Exact original gap.id or fragment.id; record IDs alone cannot discharge all obligations.
common.aggregate: Any contradiction =>FAIL; otherwise any unobserved=>INCOMPLETE; no unsupported-as-pass. Evaluate independent primitive obligations even when other facts are absent.
common.sourceRole: Source arguments may satisfy designated source-role bindings only; never replace required runtime observation or produce a semantic pass.
common.identity: Keep actual thrown reason references in local channel. Strict reference comparisons occur within actor child before serialization; labels/digests never prove identity. Propagate actual throws unchanged.

assertions.call: async or synchronous local function; no IO/import/spawn
assertions.receipt: Existing v4 receipt.capture shape, raw artifact already persisted; no golden rewriting.
assertions.fragments: Exact FRAGMENTS-371 rows selected by projectionId; unknown/duplicate/missing bindings remain unobserved or error, not ignored.
assertions.observations: Array of observation rows, schema below; assertions consume only authorized matching bindingIds.
assertions.sourceArguments: Array of bound source results, each role source-static-counterproof; do not infer runtime facts from them.
assertions.local: Null or caller-owned identity-reference object; must not serialize or inspect arbitrary getters; peer declares exact enrolled identity keys.
assertions.detail: finite string; evidenceRefs exact capture/source artifact references; unbound is dense array of original binding IDs

actors.task: Own-data descriptor with id,recordId,bindingIds,fragmentIds,environment,fixtureReference,actorKind. No new policy expected values.
actors.namespace: Locally supplied already authenticated compiled direct-module namespace; use only declared factories, no public YqLimits/private DI/hooks. Not serializable and never supplied by synthetic packet as candidate code.
actors.limits: Explicit caller-selected finite capture/event/time/storage values; peer declares requirements. Missing admission => refuse before work.
actors.capture: Existing capture fields stdoutHex,stderrHex,status,rejected,rejection,effects,events,cleanupErrors; captured before assertions. Rejection JSON is descriptive only, actual identity stays local.
actors.facts: Finite own-data facts with actor-declared keys, no private instrumentation fiction.
actors.local: Null or in-child identity references. Future bridge owns serialization exclusion.
actors.runWorkerCompatibility: Peers may export runWorker(api) wrappers but may not assume new api.captureActor or namespace API. Common local captureActor runs only inside a future separately sealed loader bridge. Existing captureSemantic cannot provide arbitrary actor namespace: that bridge is an explicit pending integration dependency, not implemented by this ABI.

sourceArguments.readSource: Harness callback reads only selected source bytes as DATA; no product module evaluation. Worker binds complete guarded271 source tree.
sourceArguments.authority: {commit,path,sha256,pointer,role}; independently sealed source inspection, never product author pass.
sourceArguments.dependency: {path,revision,sha256,bytes,mode,spans:[{startLine,endLine,sha256}]}; exact selected origin/manifest equality; UTF8 line spans include final LF as explicitly declared by argument data.
sourceArguments.result: Bound source rows use SOURCE_ARGUMENT_BOUND, absent rows UNRUN_SOURCE_ARGUMENT; malformed/unbound provenance refuses. Binding is not proof-truth, independent review or full record PASS.
sourceArguments.worker: New source-audit runWorker(api) reads sourceManifest/sourceProofPlan/sourceOrigins/coverageAllocation/sourceArguments through existing readBoundJson, captures raw identities+argument bundle before evaluating binding, writes source-only report, guards before/after.

contribution.module: {path,sha256,bytes,mode}; exact complete peer source/tool/import seal required before integration
contribution.costs: {outerSlots,nestedTools,wallMs,stdoutBytes,stderrBytes,metadataBytes,storageBytes,events}; explicit nonnegative integer requirements, not granted budgets

limits: No whole recipe/targetGO created; future root reviews exact assembly/source/tool/loader and amended cost accounting.
executionNow: Only separately committed finite synthetic recipe; no candidate imports/compiler/target controls
